messages.summary:
## Objective
- Replace the existing game with a complete, playable game matching the user’s “All wrong” request.

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For screenshots, save small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Interpreted “All wrong” as a trivia game where players score by choosing an incorrect answer.
- Built a 10-question timed game with shuffled answer choices, streak and score tracking, and a saved personal best.

## Work State
### Completed

## Objective
- Replace the existing game with a complete, playable game matching the user’s “All wrong” request.

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when finished.
- For screenshots, save small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Interpreted “All wrong” as trivia where players score by choosing an incorrect answer.
- Built a 10-question timed game with shuffled questions and choices, streak and score tracking, personal best, keyboard selection, and optional sound.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced the Cloudbound interface with All Wrong branding and responsive styling.
- Implemented the game flow, timer, feedback, results screen, and saved personal best.
- Fixed results logic to correctly show “NEW BEST!” when the score beats the previous best.
- Checked `game.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Tested a correct answer, timeout, successful wrong answers, and a complete 10-round game in Playwright; results screen and best-score updates rendered.
- Saved and inspected `/tmp/opencode/allwrong-game.jpg` at a 1280px viewport.

### Active
- Browser testing is currently on round 2 after scoring with a wrong answer; exhaustive edge-case testing remains incomplete.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue browser checks for result-screen “NEW BEST!” after clearing the existing saved best and completing a higher-scoring game.
2. Check the home and game views at a mobile viewport, then run `node --check game.js` and report the build and assumption.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: All Wrong app shell and metadata.
- `game.js`: Questions, game flow, timing, scoring, and results.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive layouts.
- `favicon.svg`: All Wrong icon.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local HTTP server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Browser local storage contains an old personal best of `3025`, which can interfere with testing the new-best state; clear `all-wrong-best` or local storage before that check.
